card.name: H in flu strain names
card.fires_on: The letter H starting influenza subtype names such as H5N1, H7N9 and H1N1, mostly in bird flu and swine flu news. It also fires on a few words right before flu or vaccine terms.

modes.label: Flu subtype H
modes.description: The H that opens an influenza strain name, just before the number and N.
modes.example: geographic distribution of<< H>>7N9 infections and fatalities in China

modes.label: Words before flu or vaccine terms
modes.description: Short word starts or linking words in flu and vaccine passages, such as about, anti or inactivated.

card.writes: It pushes toward odd name fragments and away from vaccine words, so it mainly marks that a strain name is being spelled out.
card.plain: It lights up on the H at the start of bird flu and swine flu strain names like H5N1.
